correctness.rationale: The source expands (1+u)^(-2) in a Taylor series restricted to |u|<1 and integrates it over [xi,infinity). More decisively, the absolute kth integrated term is bounded below by a positive multiple of Gamma(k+3,theta*xi)/theta^(k+1), and an elementary unit-interval lower bound proves this tends to infinity. The exact replacement follows from an algebraic partial-fraction decomposition and three elementary/E1 integrals. Direct quadrature agrees with the packaged formula at high precision.

value.rationale: Mean residual life is a central reliability descriptor explicitly developed as a structural property of the new unit distribution. The published representation is claimed to enable numerical evaluation but diverges for every admissible parameter and threshold, so it is unusable precisely for its stated purpose. The exact E1 formula restores a globally valid and directly computable reliability quantity rather than merely flagging a derivational technicality.
